en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Revolutionary song about a young fighter at Smilevo; origin unclear, I cannot name an author. Verbs ending in -ит (греит, смеит) are dialect forms; 'до Бога' and 'з'ш' are unclear, my reading.

lines.en: The sultry hot sun is burning

lines.cyr: и никој на земјата не смеит
lines.lat: i nikoj na zemjata ne smeit
lines.en: and no one on earth dares
to open their eyes, hurrah, hurrah.

lines.cyr: И никој на земјата не смеит
lines.lat: I nikoj na zemjata ne smeit
lines.en: And no one on earth dares
to open their eyes, forward, forward.

lines.cyr: Ја народ црнеит, таму на брегот
lines.lat: Ja narod crneit, tamu na bregot
lines.en: The people grow dark there on the shore
and at night an angel cried out clearly:

lines.cyr: „О Боже, до кога и до кога“?
lines.lat: „O Bože, do koga i do koga“?
lines.en: "Oh God, until when and until when?"
And at night an angel cried out clearly:

lines.cyr: „О Боже, до кога и до Бога“?
lines.lat: „O Bože, do koga i do Boga“?
lines.en: "Oh God, until when and until God?"
Hey, there at Smilevo a fight began
with the five-hundred-year-old tyrant,

lines.cyr: крв ќе се излеит, ура, ура.
lines.lat: krv ḱe se izleit, ura, ura.
lines.en: blood will be spilled, hurrah, hurrah.
With the five-hundred-year-old tyrant

lines.cyr: крв ќе се излеит, напред, напред.
lines.lat: krv ḱe se izleit, napred, napred.
lines.en: blood will be spilled, forward, forward.
And today, mother, a young hero
threw himself at the bloodthirsty tyrant,

lines.cyr: за да се одмаздит, ура, ура.
lines.lat: za da se odmazdit, ura, ura.
lines.en: to take revenge, hurrah, hurrah.
He threw himself at the bloodthirsty tyrant,

lines.cyr: за да се одмаздит, напред, напред.
lines.lat: za da se odmazdit, napred, napred.
lines.en: to take revenge, forward, forward.

lines.cyr: Но и за жалост, угасна младост
lines.lat: No i za žalost, ugasna mladost
lines.en: But alas, his youth was extinguished,

lines.cyr: свиреп го куршум в' срце погоди,
lines.lat: svirep go kuršum v' srce pogodi,
lines.en: a cruel bullet struck him in the heart,

lines.cyr: со знаме во рака, ура, ура.
lines.lat: so zname vo raka, ura, ura.
lines.en: with a flag in his hand, hurrah, hurrah.

lines.cyr: Свиреп го куршум в' срце погоди,
lines.lat: Svirep go kuršum v' srce pogodi,
lines.en: A cruel bullet struck him in the heart,

lines.cyr: со знаме во рака, напред, напред.
lines.lat: so zname vo raka, napred, napred.
lines.en: with a flag in his hand, forward, forward.
Farewell, forgive us, young hero,
soon freedom will rise
over Macedonia, hurrah, hurrah.
Soon freedom will rise
over Macedonia, forward, forward.
